note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 28 May 1902; two councillors for each division. Killyman: "as no nominations were received for this district, the old councillors stay on" (not named, not filed). The Lisnadill (A. M'Kenna, B. O'Toole, D. M'Parland, all N.) and Middletown (P. M'Donald, J. Quinn, P. Corr, all N.) contests were not found in the reports read and are not filed. Polled 28 May 1902. Printed "Cladybeg" in the results. Gray and Vallely tied on 148; "on lots being cast Gray was elected". Corr was nominated as "C. O. Corr".
